h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jalandhar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jalandhar

items.pText: Jalandhar is known across India for making sports goods, and its schools and colonies take outdoor play seriously. The city has very hot summers and cold, foggy winters, so play equipment here has to be comfortable and safe in both. FunPlay Systems manufactures playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,360 km away, and sends it to Punjab by road.

Winter is the season buyers in Punjab most often forget to plan for. On a December morning, bare metal handrails and seats are cold to the touch, and fog or dew leaves every surface damp. Roto-moulded slides, seats and panels do not feel as cold as metal, and they stay cooler in the summer sun too. We take both seasons into account when we suggest equipment for your site and mark the safe play area on the layout.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Choose roto-moulded seats on swings and see-saws instead of bare metal, which children will avoid in winter. After heavy fog or dew, let the sun dry the equipment before morning play. Rubber flooring stays less slippery than tiles or polished stone when damp. Place the play area where it gets morning sun in winter, and add summer shade with a deciduous tree or a pergola. That way the same spot works in both seasons.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,360 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Does playground equipment get slippery in Jalandhar's winter fog?
items.a: Any surface gets damp in fog or dew. Let the sun dry the equipment before morning play, and use rubber flooring, which stays less slippery than tiles or stone when wet.

items.q: Which seat material is better for cold weather?
items.a: Roto-moulded plastic seats do not feel as cold as bare metal on a winter morning. They also stay cooler in the summer sun, so they suit Punjab's weather in both seasons.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Punjab?
items.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Jalandhar and other Punjab cities by road, and install it with our own team or a dealer in North India.
